decision.reason: [ev-4fcf47388827] says only that cert-manager now uses a local fork of the `golang.org/x/crypto/acme` package. It points to PR #7752, which isn't shown. It doesn't say whether ACME client behaviour, requests or supported features changed, and it names no configuration, flag or field that would decide which environments are exposed. Nothing else in the section restates this change. [ev-7be235e771a3] (ACME profiles support, same author) may be related, but linking the two would be a guess. So the change and applicability can't be written from the text; the PR description or diff is needed.
